papers.title: FAIR Universe Weak Lensing ML Uncertainty Challenge: Dataset and Cosmological Inference Competition
papers.comment: 10+7 pages, 2+4 figures, 2+1 tables. Key results of the NeurIPS 2025 FAIR Universe Weak Lensing ML Challenge Phase 1. The challenge dataset is publicly available at Zenodo: https://zenodo.org/records/20056065. Challenge GitHub repository: https://github.com/FAIR-Universe/Cosmology_Challenge
papers.summary: Presents the FAIR Universe weak-lensing ML uncertainty challenge, with a realistic benchmark dataset containing systematics and the winning solutions, including vision transformers, ensembles and AI agents.
papers.tldr: This work presents the FAIR Universe Weak Lensing Machine Learning Uncertainty Challenge, one of the NeurIPS 2025 competitions, as a benchmark dataset and evaluation study, and summarizes the main methodological advances developed by the winners.

papers.title: SWXAI: A Unified Multimodal Explainability Library for Space Weather Forecasting and Heliophysics
papers.comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at CIKM 2026 (Resource Track), Rome, Italy, November 7-11, 2026. Code: https://bitbucket.org/gsudmlab/swxai Docs: https://swxai.readthedocs.io
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM '26), 2026
papers.summary: Introduces SWXAI, an open-source library unifying explainable-AI workflows for images, time series and tabular data in space weather and heliophysics forecasting models.
papers.tldr: SWXAI reduces modality-specific engineering overhead and supports comparable, reusable explanations across heterogeneous scientific machine learning pipelines, and a benchmark against direct backend implementations shows that SWXAI substantially reduces the code users write to produce an explanation, with no practical runtime cost.

papers.title: Deep-Learning-Assisted Bayesian Inference for Extreme-Mass-Ratio Inspirals
papers.summary: Combines neural-network-guided parameter-space localization with particle swarm optimization and MCMC to recover EMRI posteriors from simulated six-month signals without prior knowledge of true parameters.
papers.tldr: A deep-learning-assisted Bayesian inference framework that combines neural-network-guided parameter-space localization, particle swarm optimization, and Markov chain Monte Carlo sampling and recovers posterior distributions in close agreement with reference MCMC analyses initialized near the true parameter values.

papers.title: MapHub: Daily Relevance Heatmaps of New arXiv Preprints for a Research Community
papers.comment: 3 pages, 1 figure, matches version accepted for publication
papers.summary: An LLM scores daily arXiv submissions against researcher portfolios and publishes relevance heatmaps, placing about 70% of blind-rated top papers in its top decile.

papers.title: Classical Cepheids in the 4MOST era I: Methodology for 4MOST variable stars and NLTE abundance gradients in the Milky Way
papers.comment: 24 pages, 19 figures, Accepted for publication by A&A
papers.summary: An artificial neural network trained on non-LTE spectra derives Cepheid atmospheric parameters and 17 elemental abundances, producing Milky Way radial abundance gradients for 4MOST.

papers.title: Scalable early warning for binary neutron-star mergers in third-generation gravitational-wave detectors
papers.summary: CNN on short-time Fourier transforms detects binary neutron-star mergers hours before merger in Einstein Telescope simulations, matching matched filtering at four orders lower computational cost.

papers.title: MarsNet: Learning the Martian Atmosphere from Observations Alone
papers.summary: A learned Martian atmosphere model alternates two-hour forecasts with bounded Kalman observation updates, matching reanalyses near the surface and improving surface pressures on withheld observations.
